authority_contract.gcl10: Adventure structures are reusable proposal inputs; GCL-11 may adapt them into session-sized preparation without creating Adventure truth or silently consuming unreached branches.
authority_contract.f005: Campaign, Scene, Session, membership, Character-control, launch snapshot, Event and projection authority remain MV-IA-F005/A5; GCL-11 creates no live Session state and performs no launch.
authority_contract.f012: Encounter composition, participants, objectives, analysis and live Encounter state remain MV-IA-F012 authority.
authority_contract.csw05: Plot/Adventure/Narrative Lab structure remains pre-authoritative; session kits may reference authorized planning context but cannot incorporate it automatically.
authority_contract.a9: Investigation-heavy kits preserve A9 objective-truth, clue, discovery, evidence, hypothesis and hidden-information boundaries.
authority_contract.attendance: Absent/extra/late/early participants are planning conditions only; no kit grants membership, role, Character control or permission.
authority_contract.timing: Real-world time budgets may guide preparation; a live fiction clock exists only when an owning runtime domain establishes it.
authority_contract.ai: Optional proposal-only and authorization-filtered; no auto-launch, live mutation, hidden-context access or authoritative recap generation.
